lines.7: 「If there's a place where that's ordinary, I want to go there.」
lines.12: 「I'm past feeling smug. Now I'm worried someone might attack us.」
lines.22: 「Come to think of it, how are you at sports?」
lines.25: 「I dislike bowling. I score around sixty.」
lines.27: 「I have difficulty striking the ball straight.」
lines.30: Come to think of it, she walks slowly too.
lines.31: The Executive Committee has so many martial types that I forgot.
lines.33: 「No. I'm not leaving you here alone!」
lines.37: 「I will watch the luggage here. Swim as you please.」
lines.38: Inori puts on sunglasses and lies down.
lines.39: 「What an incredible figure... I'm worried some creep will come buzzing around.」
lines.40: 「Birds eat bugs. You'll be fine while I keep my dashing eye on things.」
lines.41: 「Good. Be her bodyguard for a while.」
lines.42: 「I'm getting her into the sea somehow.」
lines.43: 「First, I need something from the beach hut...」
lines.45: 「Hah... hah... Inori, let's play in the water.」
lines.46: 「I already said I cannot swim and will not learn...」
lines.47: 「Right. I found a perfectly legitimate solution that requires neither.」
lines.48: Smiling, I present the product of ten minutes of hard work.
lines.50: 「It was hard to inflate that much.」
lines.52: 「How rude. I am not that unathletic.」
lines.53: I swim hard, towing the inflatable. It isn't technically a swim ring, but I don't know its name.
lines.55: Even in the water, everyone stares at Inori.
lines.56: A glamorous woman in a daring swimsuit will do that.
lines.58: The waves rock her chest along with the float.
lines.59: 「I'm not letting those other guys stare at you.」
lines.66: I swim with all my strength.
lines.68: Inori narrows her eyes pleasantly in the sea breeze.
lines.69: 「The ocean isn't so bad, is it?」
lines.71: Inori has turned into a speed freak.
